description: Defines the AnyValue class, an implementation similar to std::any, for type-erased storage and retrieval of objects within the torch::nn namespace.

classes.name: AnyValue
classes.description: A class implementing type-erased storage similar to std::any, allowing runtime type checking and retrieval.

methods.name: try_get
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a pointer to the stored value of type T, returns nullptr if types do not match.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the stored value of type T, throws an error if the type does not match.
